landing.heroDescription: Record a quick audio after each meeting. Our AI transcribes, identifies contacts and companies, extracts tasks and decisions. Everything organized in your CRM in seconds.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: From meeting to action in less than a minute
landing.step1Desc: Left the meeting? Open the app and tell what happened. No typing, no forms, no hassle. Speak naturally as if you were telling a colleague.
landing.step2Desc: Advanced artificial intelligence transcribes the audio, identifies people and companies mentioned, extracts tasks and deadlines, and organizes important decisions.
landing.step3Desc: Contacts created, companies linked, tasks queued and decisions recorded. All automatic. Open the CRM and see everything organized, ready for action.
landing.feature1Desc: Record with one tap. Pause and resume anytime. Auto-pause when your phone rings or the screen turns off.
landing.feature2Desc: Audio converted to text with impressive accuracy. Full support for Brazilian Portuguese.
landing.feature3Desc: Mentioned someone in the audio? The contact is automatically created and linked to the meeting.
landing.feature4Desc: Companies identified and created automatically. Contacts grouped by company.
landing.feature5Desc: AI identifies commitments, deadlines and mentioned actions and creates tasks automatically.
landing.feature6Desc: Track meetings by month, view summaries and CRM metrics in intuitive charts.
landing.painDescription: Leave the meeting, hit traffic, arrive at the office and already forgot half of what was agreed. Names, deadlines, decisions... all lost. Until now.
landing.benefit1: Record meetings in seconds, not minutes
landing.benefit2: Contacts and companies created without typing
landing.benefit4: Complete history of each contact and company
landing.demoTranscript: "I talked to <1>Marcos da Silva</1> from <3>TechBrasil</3>. He wants to close the contract by Friday. I need to send the <5>updated proposal</5> with the new values and schedule an <7>alignment call</7> with his technical team..."
landing.ctaDescription: Start using VoiceCRM now and turn your meetings into concrete actions.
landing.ctaDisclaimer: No credit card. No commitment. Cancel anytime.
landing.trustTitle: Built for those who have no time to waste
landing.trust1Desc: Your data is encrypted and protected. Each user can only access their own information. Privacy is a priority.
landing.trust2Desc: Designed for mobile first. Open the app and start recording instantly. Add to your home screen and use it like a native app.
landing.trust3Desc: Stop writing meeting minutes. Stop filling out spreadsheets. Speak for 30 seconds and save 30 minutes of manual work.
landing.trust4Desc: Uses the most advanced artificial intelligence models for transcription and analysis. Impressive accuracy in Brazilian Portuguese.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
privacy.dataCollectionText:
VoiceCRM collects the following data to provide the service:

- Audio recordings of your meetings
- Transcriptions generated from audio
- Contact information (name, email, phone, role, company)
- Meeting data (title, summary, date, participants)
- Tasks and decisions extracted from meetings
- Account information (name, email, encrypted password)
privacy.dataProcessingText:
Your data is processed as follows:

- Recorded audio is sent to the OpenAI API (Whisper) for automatic transcription
- The transcription is processed by artificial intelligence (GPT) to extract entities such as contacts, companies, tasks, and decisions
- Extracted data is organized and stored in your personal CRM
- AI processing occurs in real time after each recording
privacy.dataStorageText:
Your data is stored as follows:

- All data is stored in a secure PostgreSQL database
- Data remains stored as long as your account is active
- When you delete your account, all associated data is permanently removed
- Database backups are maintained for recovery in case of technical failures
privacy.userRightsText:
You have the following rights over your data:

- Access: You can view all your data at any time through the VoiceCRM dashboard
- Correction: You can edit and correct any contact, company, meeting, and task information
- Deletion: You can delete individual meetings or delete your entire account and data permanently
- Portability: Your data can be exported through the system's reporting features
privacy.dataSecurityText:
We implement the following security measures:

- Passwords are encrypted using secure hashing algorithms (scrypt)
- Session-based authentication with secure tokens
- Per-user data isolation: each user can only access their own data
- Encrypted communication via HTTPS
- Validation and sanitization of all data inputs
privacy.contactText:
To exercise your rights or clarify questions about your data, please contact us:

Email: privacy@voicecrm.app

We will respond to your request within 15 business days.
privacy.termsText:
By using VoiceCRM, you agree to the following terms:

- The service is provided for personal and professional use of customer relationship management
- You are responsible for the content of recordings and the accuracy of information entered
- Using the service for illegal or harmful activities is strictly prohibited
- We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms
- The service may undergo scheduled updates and maintenance
- We do not guarantee uninterrupted service availability
privacy.consentText:
By creating an account and using VoiceCRM, you declare that:

- You have read and understood this privacy policy and terms of use
- You consent to the collection and processing of your data as described above
- You have the right to record the meetings and conversations you register in the system
- You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting your account
